axioms.name: Origin Point
axioms.statement: Zero is a single dimensionless point (locus count 1, extension 0). It is the anchor of all measure.

axioms.name: Ur-Prime
axioms.statement: The number 1 is the first prime (Ur-Prime), containing the Monadic Polarity: the Origin Point (0) and the unit whole (1). Its internal two-valuedness makes it irreducible.

axioms.name: Spatial Support
axioms.statement: Star-Prime atoms are embedded via x_k = (a_k-1)/(2(a_k+1)), yielding strictly real coordinates in (0, 1/2) on the Axial Diameter. Only the complex exponentiation x_k^{-s} expands their influence into the transverse s-plane.

axioms.name: Monadic Reflection
axioms.statement: The coupling A_ξ F(s) = F(s) + F(1-s) enforces s ↔ 1-s symmetry. It guarantees that zeros occur in pairs ρ, 1-ρ but does not force them onto the critical line.

axioms.name: Transverse Residual Hypothesis (TRH)
axioms.statement: For a Monadic Measure μ, the zeros of F_μ(s) include Spectral Transverse Zeros (Re(s) ≠ 1/2). A constrained coupling maps these transverse modes to the critical line, producing the observed Riemann zeros as projections.
